QuestInfo.name: Waiting, and Waiting, and Waiting
QuestInfo.0: Wait for Evan, who's gone to Turtle Island to get information for you. \r\nTalk to Utah to see how much longer you have to wait.
QuestInfo.1: Speak to Utah again in three minutes.
QuestInfo.2: Three minutes have gone by. Evan's back! Gee, that was some fast flying!

1.0: Hey, you're right! Three minutes are up! Evan should be back any minute now.
